title: Formal Sciences Skeleton v1
description: Coverage skeleton for the formal-sciences continent (second continent, CPO-selected 2026-06-10): field/subfield two-level node set under domain:formal-sciences — mathematics, statistics, mathematical logic, and systems-science areas — each tagged with academic_status. Construction input only — not canonical graph data; nodes only, zero edges (skeleton-first). Also carries the five existing /data formal-sciences nodes that are still QID-less (ML-foundations legacy) as resolver grounding targets.

include: Formal-sciences field and subfield coverage skeleton (nodes only)
Mathematics, statistics, mathematical logic, and systems-science areas, including historical and applied areas
Wikidata QID resolution for identity and external_ids
QID grounding for existing /data formal-sciences nodes that lack one (ML-foundations legacy)
exclude: Edges and relations (skeleton-first: dots before lines)
Level-3 concepts, persons, works (beyond grounding the two existing legacy concepts)
Computer and information sciences (separate continent; field:computer-science and field:machine-learning stay out of scope)
Philosophical logic (subfield:logic stays in humanities; cross-listing policy is parked)

External-link / source-resolution pointer only. Never store or cache article bodies.

forbidden_sources.reason: NamuWiki is external-link-only and must never be used as evidence or a source, nor have its content cached.
No cloud LLM API calls are permitted in repo tooling, build, validation, or runtime.
Scraping or crawling third-party article bodies is forbidden; only open, license-compatible data is allowed.

notes: Continent selection and scope ratified by the CPO 2026-06-10 (vault decision log (12)).

Seeds = the five QID-less legacy /data nodes + the 39 QC-passed proposal nodes, generated mechanically from foundry/proposals/formal-sciences-skeleton-v1/proposal.json (same flow as philosophy-skeleton-v1, PR #18).

Coverage baseline for generation/QC: UDC class 51 (mathematics) and 519.2 (probability/statistics), LCC subclass QA (excluding QA75-76 computing), MSC 2020 top-level sections, and top-university mathematics/statistics department structures.
/data remains the source of truth for accepted graph data.
